# Plot UMAP 

## Highlighting cells

```{r}
Idents(sc_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

sc_combined$highlight_cells <- "immune"

sc_combined$highlight_cells[sc_combined$seurat_clusters == "Satellite cells"] <- "Satellite cells"
sc_combined$highlight_cells[sc_combined$seurat_clusters == "Myoblasts"] <- "Myoblasts"
sc_combined$highlight_cells[sc_combined$seurat_clusters == "Myonuclei"] <- "Myonuclei"
sc_combined$highlight_cells[sc_combined$seurat_clusters == "Endothelial cells"] <- "Endothelial cells"
sc_combined$highlight_cells[sc_combined$seurat_clusters == "vSMCs"] <- "vSMCs"
sc_combined$highlight_cells[sc_combined$seurat_clusters == "Pericytes"] <- "Pericytes"
sc_combined$highlight_cells[sc_combined$seurat_clusters == "FAPs"] <- "FAPs"
sc_combined$highlight_cells[sc_combined$seurat_clusters == "Tenocytes"] <- "Tenocytes"
sc_combined$highlight_cells[sc_combined$seurat_clusters == "Neural/glial cells"] <- "Neural/glial cells"
sc_combined$highlight_cells[sc_combined$seurat_clusters == "Schwann cells"] <- "Schwann cells"

DimPlot(
  sc_combined,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "highlight_cells",
  cols = c(
    "immune" = "grey85",
    "Satellite cells" = "#FF7FBF",
    "Myoblasts" = "#FF3F80",
    "Myonuclei" = "#E00000",
    "Endothelial cells" = "#FFFF00",     
    "vSMCs" = "#BC9D00",
    "Pericytes" = "#8B5A2B",
    "FAPs" = "#7CFC00",
    "Tenocytes" = "#228B22",
    "Neural/glial cells" = "#FF7F00", 
    "Schwann cells" = "#FFA64D"
  ),
  pt.size = 1, raster = FALSE
) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = NULL, x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

## Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(cellchat_ctl_ecm, cellchat_ctl_ccc, cellchat_ctl_nps, cellchat_tb_ecm, cellchat_tb_ccc, cellchat_tb_nps)
```



# Enriched signaling pathways from Tumour to muscle non-immune cells

```{r}
### Extract communication probabilities at the pathway level
netP_tb_secreted <- subsetCommunication(cellchat_tb_secreted, slot.name = "netP")

### Subset for enriched pathways for target cells to source cells
netP_tb_secreted <- netP_tb_secreted[
  netP_tb_secreted$source %in% c("Tumour Tumour cells", "Tumour Endothelial cells", "Tumour Cancer-associated fibroblasts", "Tumour Monocytes/macrophages", "Tumour Neutrophils", "Tumour B cells", "Tumour T cells", "Tumour NK cells") & 
  netP_tb_secreted$target %in% c("Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei", "Muscle Endothelial cells", "Muscle vSMCs", "Muscle Pericytes", "Muscle FAPs", "Muscle Tenocytes", "Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells"), 
]

### Get unique pathways from specified cells to target cells
unique(netP_tb_secreted$pathway_name)
```

## Dotplot of enriched signaling from tumour to muscle

```{r, include=FALSE}
selectK(cellchat_ctl_secreted, pattern = "outgoing")
selectK(cellchat_ctl_secreted, pattern = "incoming")

selectK(cellchat_tb_secreted, pattern = "outgoing")
selectK(cellchat_tb_secreted, pattern = "incoming")

cellchat_ctl_secreted <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat_ctl_secreted, pattern = "outgoing", k = 6)
cellchat_ctl_secreted <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat_ctl_secreted, pattern = "incoming", k = 5)

cellchat_tb_secreted <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat_tb_secreted, pattern = "outgoing", k = 10)
cellchat_tb_secreted <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat_tb_secreted, pattern = "incoming", k = 6)
```

```{r}
netAnalysis_dot(cellchat_tb_secreted, pattern = "outgoing", pathway.show = c("OSM", "MIF", "SPP1", "GALECTIN", "GRN"), group.show = c("Tumour Tumour cells", "Tumour Endothelial cells", "Tumour Cancer-associated fibroblasts", "Tumour Monocytes/macrophages", "Tumour Neutrophils", "Tumour B cells", "Tumour T cells", "Tumour NK cells"), color.use = cluster_colours)
```

```{r}
netAnalysis_dot(cellchat_tb_secreted, pattern = "incoming", pathway.show = c("OSM", "MIF", "SPP1", "GALECTIN", "GRN"), group.show = c("Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei", "Muscle Endothelial cells", "Muscle vSMCs", "Muscle Pericytes", "Muscle FAPs", "Muscle Tenocytes", "Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells"), color.use = cluster_colours)
```

```{r}
  netP_C26_end_all$source %in% c("Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei", "Muscle Endothelial cells", "Muscle vSMCs", "Muscle Pericytes", "Muscle FAPs", "Muscle Tenocytes", "Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells") & 
  netP_C26_end_all$target %in% c("Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei", "Muscle Endothelial cells", "Muscle vSMCs", "Muscle Pericytes", "Muscle FAPs", "Muscle Tenocytes", "Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells"),
]

### Get unique pathways from specified cells to target cells
unique(netP_C26_end_all$pathway_name)
```
